purpose: ROOT visual recovery open-source toolchain registry

policy.runtime_rule: Only add production dependencies that materially improve the site. Clone/reference-only tools stay outside the production dependency graph.
policy.license_rule: Do not vendor or copy AGPL code into ROOT production code. Preserve notices for permissive-license code that is incorporated.
policy.tailwind_rule: Tailwind remains disabled in the ROOT production render path. Tailwind-based repositories may be used as visual/reference sources only unless a future architecture decision explicitly changes this.
policy.phi_rule: Use synthetic/deidentified content only in local visual tooling, demos, recordings, screenshots, and third-party tools.

repositories.name: HyperFrames
repositories.active_use: Turn approved ROOT/DIRT HTML experiences and case studies into deterministic launch/demo videos. Use agent skills and local rendering; do not make the website depend on the renderer.

repositories.name: Recordly
repositories.active_use: Record polished product/site walkthroughs with zoom, framing, cursor treatment, and MP4/GIF export. Never copy or link Recordly source into ROOT production code without a separate license review.

repositories.name: Dasimaginare
repositories.active_use: Reuse image-discovery, search, preview, loading-state and media-selection patterns. ROOT media remains downloaded/build-time with provenance; never add a runtime Pixabay dependency to the public site.

repositories.name: Magic UI
repositories.active_use: Mine high-quality interaction and visual-effect patterns. Adapt only patterns that fit Clinical Glass; do not reactivate Tailwind merely to consume Magic UI components.

repositories.name: Motion
repositories.active_use: Use for deliberate hero motion, layout transitions, scroll/reveal choreography, and reduced-motion-aware micro-interactions where CSS alone is insufficient.

repositories.name: Radix Primitives
repositories.active_use: Use incrementally for accessible dialog, navigation, menu, disclosure, focus-management, and other interaction primitives instead of hand-rolling accessibility behavior.

repositories.name: Splide
repositories.active_use: Use as the accessible, lightweight case-study/proof carousel engine instead of maintaining bespoke carousel behavior across every POC.

repositories.name: Playwright
repositories.active_use: Use for deterministic desktop/mobile visual regression capture, interaction smoke tests, route coverage, and release screenshots so visual QA becomes repeatable instead of manual.
